message: v1.8.2: Release v1.8.2: extension auto-update, post-update changelog, stale file cleanup, dead file removal
changelog: Windows Desktop Companion Release Packaging (windows-widget/, export/extension/workflows/release.yml): Added the .NET 8 BlackboarderWidget Windows desktop and lock screen companion source into windows-widget/ and updated the public release workflow to compile and attach BlackboarderWidget.exe on every GitHub release so in-app download links work without 404 errors.

Documentation, Landing Page, & Guide Alignment (README.md, export/extension/README.md, docs/, AGENTS.md, mobile-web/index.html): Updated installation, quick-start, and FAQ docs across both repositories and the landing page to point to Settings > Updates (Automatic Updates & Show Changelog After Update toggles) instead of the old manual update.bat / update.sh setup step, fixed the desktop widget reference to Settings > General, and removed stale wallpaper / shortcut copy.
